data.summary: As an agent, taking over another agent EXPIRED lease is meant to be: ddflow claim <id> --approval request (an agent --force is dropped; _take_over names --approval request). But api/lifecycle/claim.py claim() only reaches _claim_by_approval when the refusal reason contains the literal "--force"; the expired-lease LeaseError reason says "To take it over: ...ddflow claim <id> --approval request" (no "--force"), so --approval request is swallowed and the same refusal returns (exit 3) with nothing filed (no approval id). Workaround: temporarily set lease.reclaim_policy=auto (local config) or claim as the dead holder to hit resume_own.
data.title: claim --approval request swallowed for a foreign expired lease

data.body:
Fixes bug Be62e44611e: As an agent, taking over another agent EXPIRED lease is meant to be: ddflow claim <id> --approval request (an agent --force is dropped; _take_over names --approval request). But api/lifecycle/claim.py claim() only reaches _claim_by_approval when the refusal reason contains the literal "--force"; the expired-lease LeaseError reason says "To take it over: ...ddflow claim <id> --approval request" (no "--force"), so --approval request is swallowed and the same refusal returns (exit 3) with nothing filed (no approval id). Workaround: temporarily set lease.reclaim_policy=auto (local config) or claim as the dead holder to hit resume_own.

Write the regression test first and watch it FAIL on the unfixed code; then `ddflow complete fix-Be62e44611e --regression-test <test>` closes the bug with the task (or `ddflow bug fixed Be62e44611e --regression-test <test>` first).
data.title: Fix bug Be62e44611e: claim --approval request swallowed for a foreign expired lease
